mapper.sql: id, user_id, package_id, package_name, tokens, amount, status, qr_code_url, created_at, paid_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (id, user_id, package_id, package_name, tokens, amount, status, qr_code_url, created_at, paid_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{packageId}, #{packageName}, #{tokens}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{qrCodeUrl}, #{createdAt}, #{paidAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
